meta.name: CCNL per i lavoratori addetti alle industrie delle pelli e dei succedanei della pelle (Assopellettieri)

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobato (table pay inclusive of base pay, former contingenza, E.d.r.). Art. 32 CCNL (CNEL PDF): 'Sono conglobati in un unica voce denominata Retribuzione tabellare i seguenti istituti: paga base, ex indennita di contingenza, E.d.r.' PELLETTERIA table with 7 levels and 4 tranches (Apr 2023, Dec 2023, Dec 2024, Dec 2025) from primary source CNEL PDF Art. 32.

LEVEL 1 (testo definitivo 22/12/2023, CNEL 20201, https://cdcpcnelblg01sa.blob.core.windows.net/archivio/2023//20201.pdf, sha256 f81f9d1fb9118271af0d597ec48802c931af6f063e8ae16c89f90fe1cc4ca954): level 1 is no longer a classification level for permanent workers (art. 102), but art. 72 (PDF p. 106) keeps 'due livelli sotto quello di destinazione finale' in the first period, so an apprentice destined to the 3rd starts at level 1; apprentices destined to the 2nd 'dal 01 gennaio 2024 saranno inquadrati al livello di destinazione finale sin dal primo periodo' (modelled). The pelletteria table (art. 101, PDF p. 137) gives level 1 only up to 1,311.66 from 1/12/2023 and leaves the columns from 1/12/2024 and 1/12/2025 blank: the 1,345.76 and 1,379.86 of the file for those periods are not in the text, and pay the first period of an apprentice destined to the 3rd.

limitation.remediation: Source the level 1 minimo from 1 December 2024 for the first period of the apprentices destined to the 3rd level.

notes.text: HOURLY DIVISOR 173: Art. 35 CCNL (CNEL PDF): 'La retribuzione e oraria e si ottiene dividendo la retribuzione mensile per 173'.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS 13: tredicesima (thirteenth month). Source: ANCL summary CCNL D111.
SENIORITY INCREMENTS: Art. 54 CCNL (CNEL PDF). 'quattro aumenti biennali periodici di anzianita' — 24-month cadence, maximum 4. Per-level amounts from Art. 54 CNEL PDF table.

APPRENTICESHIP: Art. 55 CCNL (CNEL PDF). Under-classification model, maximum duration 36 months. Six distinct tracks (one per destination level) with specific pay progression for each level, as per Art. 55 table. Special note for level 2: 'Gli apprendisti con destinazione finale al secondo saranno inquadrati al livello di destinazione finale con decorrenza dall'inizio del secondo periodo di apprendistato' (from month 11 onwards at level 2).

INPS: industry sector rates from 2026-industria.json (existing file reused). Employee 9.19% up to 15 employees, 9.49% above; employer (operai): <=15 employees 30.68%, 16-50 employees 31.28%, >50 employees 31.58% (impiegati and quadri 28.46%, 29.06%, 29.36%). (review of 2026-10-30)
LEVEL 6Q: not present in the CCNL table of the CNEL PDF (August 2023). Excluded from the model.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. 55 Regolamentazione dell'apprendistato professionalizzante, p. 44, CNEL archive https://cdcpcnelblg01sa.blob.core.windows.net/archivio/2023//20098.pdf, sha256 4e303eba48192399bcecd05e5e0cdc675b61c3daff40ef71b0c1e377f98203f8): 'L’intero periodo di apprendistato professionalizzante è utile ai fini della maturazione dell’anzianità aziendale, anche ai fini degli aumenti periodici di anzianità; tali aumenti saranno corrisposti nelle misure previste dal livello di appartenenza': seniority_increments.apprentice_level_amount.

location.section: Art. 57 C - Conservazione del posto
location.quote: Al lavoratore ammalato sarà conservato il posto con decorrenza dell’anzianità a tutti gli effetti contrattuali per tredici mesi. [...] L’obbligo di conservazione del posto per l’azienda cesserà comunque ove nell’arco di 30 mesi si raggiungano i limiti predetti anche con più malattie.

provenance.transformation: Art. 57 C: the job is kept thirteen months (395 days, months of 365/12 days), the sick days of the 30 months that end on the day summed, one illness alike. The pay is not in this text (the ipotesi omits letter B): the 100% integration for 180 days of an illness is carried over from the file, unverified, and ends on day 180 by a tier of rate 0 from the seventh month. Read on 2026-10-31.
provenance.note: The pay of Art. 57 B and the 2023 renewal (signed 26.05.2023, which extends the comporto of serious illnesses) were not obtained; the 15 months of the serious illnesses on life-saving therapy are not modelled. The source cited before (CNEL 20098.pdf) is the UNILAVORO PMI / UNIPEL / FILP-CONFSAL CCNL, not this one.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 28 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 0 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 72 (PDF p. 106) and art. 101 (PDF p. 137) of the testo definitivo of 22/12/2023, read on the page images.
findings: Destination 2 takes the final level from the first period from 1 January 2024.
Level 1 has no minimo from 1/12/2024 in the signed table: the 1,345.76 and 1,379.86 of the file are unsourced and stay under the narrowed limitation.
